expected.raw_text: Built and shipped agent systems in production

parsed.notes:
The qualification sections and unmarked tech-stack section supply required skills; technologies appearing only under 'What you will build' or the company description are excluded.
Agentic products are initially marked 'ideally', but production agent experience and the unmarked Agentic AI stack entry independently make agents required.
React Native is not mapped to React because the taxonomy does not contain React Native.
Data ingestion is provisionally mapped to data-pipelines; the posting names ingestion rather than pipelines explicitly in that qualification.
Ontology, knowledge graph and structured context systems are alternatives, but only knowledge graph has a taxonomy entry, so no multi-skill alternative group is emitted. ERP, CMMS, WMS, historians and PLC integration are also offered as alternatives but are unmapped.
Physical-world data modalities, industrial subject matter and general production-system considerations are read literally as domain knowledge or context, not additional named technical skills.
Seniority follows the required 3+ years; 5+ years is preferred rather than required. No German-language or degree requirement is stated.
